name: 02649 · Mashpee, MA
findings: ZIP 02649 (Mashpee) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02649 (Mashpee) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
